meta.name: data-storytelling
meta.description: 数据科学家与产品经理在向高管汇报或制作投资者演示时，当面临数据枯燥难懂的痛点，使用此技能可套用“Setup-Conflict-Resolution”叙事框架，自动生成结合可视化与业务上下文的洞察报告，让非技术受众秒懂结论并驱动决策。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将枯燥数据转化为驱动决策的清晰叙事
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你需要把数据结论清晰传达给非技术决策者
copy.tagline_en: Turn dull data into decision-driving stories for non-technical audiences
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to explain data insights to non-technical stakeholders and drive decisions

howto.what: 把数据套进 Setup→Conflict→Resolution 叙事框架,产出带图表、业务上下文和结论建议的报告或演示稿,供非技术受众理解。
howto.when: 当你向高管汇报、做季度业务回顾或投资者演示,需要把数据讲给非技术受众时,它会接管。

say.text: 帮我把这份客户流失数据写成给高管看的叙事报告
用 Setup-Conflict-Resolution 框架做月度业务回顾
say.note: 产出含关键指标与建议的回顾稿

say.text: 把这些 Q4 指标做成带可视化的趋势故事,并给出行动建议
say.note: 趋势故事会带前后对比与结论

howto.what_en: Turns raw data into a Setup-Conflict-Resolution narrative, producing reports or decks with charts, business context and recommendations for non-technical audiences.
howto.when_en: Use when presenting analytics to executives, building quarterly business reviews or investor presentations, or explaining data to non-technical audiences.

say_en.text: Turn this churn data into an executive narrative report
Build a monthly business review with this framework
Make these Q4 metrics a visual trend story with actions
